# University of Oxford — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where is University of Oxford?", "England"),
    ("What is notable about University of Oxford?", "Oldest in English world"),
    ("What is location?", "England"),
    ("What is key stat?", "1096"),
    ("What is notable fact?", "Oldest in English world"),
    ("What is note?", "39 colleges"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
